cells.gaps: Nothing shows staff trained, equipment delivered or any pilot school: the September 2023 ENT trial was only proposed, and no fact is dated after the decree of 2 November 2023. cells.note: A decree creates a per-learner SIGE with entry assigned to schools and a specification exists for an ENT covering primary schools, which is preparation; no school is recorded using either, so stage 3 is not reached. No source states that learner records are on paper, so it is not stage 1.
